liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer calls the Dark Star excellent, along with the first Mind Left Body jam; First half rides a spacey groove; after a Phil solo, the Mind Left Body jam brings melodic Garcia playing and freakout [2][3][9][14]
- **Playin' In The Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds Playin' fantastic, as good as any from 1973, while the rest of the show seemed uninspired; Reviewer calls the Playin' a monster [7][9]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer calls the extended China Cat to Rider segue among the best ever [8]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Morning Dew intense, perhaps the best version of that year [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mind Left Body Jam**: back after 124 archived shows (559 days) [15]

## The recordings

- **gd73-10-19.sbd.nayfield.187.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 180 min; rated 3.37/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Available in vault-remastered sound; reviewer notes minimal sloppiness at the start of a couple of second set tracks [8]
- **gd1973-10-19.170233.pset2.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac2496**: audience recording; 2 songs; 18 min [2]

## Around the show

- The band was returning from a break; reviewer found the setlist promising but the performance mostly uninspired [7]
- Reviewer says the band plays to its audience, so Oklahoma City Dead differs greatly from the Boston Dead [10]
- Reviewer, raised in Oklahoma, finds this release weaker than Dick's usual choices and not that good [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-10-19.sbd.nayfield.187.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Master recording went to DAT then CDR, via JW Norris and R. Nayfield; show later released as Dick's Picks 19 [1]
- **gd1973-10-19.170233.pset2.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac2496**: taped by Unknown from the collection of Doug Lamarre; transferred by Matt Vernon, Andrew F; source: Unknown audience cassettes from the collection of by Doug Lamarre. [2]. Also: Audience recording is complete except Me and My Uncle and Mississippi Half-Step, per Deadlists; first set and China Cat > Rider are very good audience [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [Grateful Dead Poster 1973-10-19 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/grateful-dead-poster-1973-10-19-19/) [16]
- Poster by auctions.yahoo.co.jp: [D05 中古CD グレイトフルデッド Grateful Dead D... - Yahoo!オークション](https://auctions.yahoo.co.jp/jp/auction/v1135748642) [17]
- Poster by auctions.yahoo.co.jp: [C11 中古CD グレイトフルデッド Grateful Dead D... - Yahoo!オークション](https://auctions.yahoo.co.jp/jp/auction/g1115097970) [18]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oklahoma City Fairgrounds Arena - October 19, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/october-19-1973) [19]
- Poster by auctions.yahoo.co.jp: [GRATEFUL DEAD - Dick's Picks Vol.19 3CD Fairg... - Yahoo!オークション](https://auctions.yahoo.co.jp/jp/auction/o1122699274) [20]
